title: Initial prepared configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $\mathrm{emit}$ be a Boolean, and let $x$ and $\mathrm{arg}$ be Boolean words. The embedded evaluator configuration obtained from the initial configuration of the right-boundary wrapper of the tracked evaluator of $M$ on $\mathrm{arg}$, with the virtual-input tag set to true and its head at position $1$, equals the initial call configuration whose first work tape stores $\mathrm{arg}$ and whose other work tapes are blank, with every work-tape head at the origin and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
replaced:
For every mode, input word, and argument word $a$: the identity relocation of the
prepared evaluator's entry configuration on $a$ equals the clean-call controller's
canonical entry seam, whose first work tape holds $a$ with all other tapes blank, heads
at their origins, and empty output.
